name: Half Baked Category Colours
author: emrysh

sections.description:
Half Baked Category Colours adds a per-category colour picker and applies those colours sitewide wherever categories are displayed.

Highlights
* Set a colour per category on Posts → Categories (add/edit).
* Optional default category colour (used when a category has no specific colour).
* Optional pill styling (rounded borders + padding), plus controls for:
* Pill gap
* Border thickness
* Pill shape
* Background tint
* Underline
* Category list screen improvements:
* Colour swatch column
* Quick Edit colour picker
* Optional category name case tools (categories only; no exceptions list):
* Storage case style (used by normalization)
* Auto-apply on create/edit
* Force display case (front end)
* Normalize all categories now
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/half-baked-category-colours/ or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Half Baked Category Colours.
  3. Go to Posts → Categories to set category colours and adjust Category Colours Settings.
sections.faq:
Where do I change category colours?

Go to Posts → Categories. You can set colours when adding/editing a category, or via Quick Edit.

What happens if I don’t set a colour?

If you’ve set a Default category colour, it will be used. Otherwise your theme’s default styling is used.

Fixes per-category colours not applying in some themes.

Ensures pill styling still renders even when no default category colour is set.

Restores front-end pill/tint styling reliability.

1.1.5

Improves styling behavior for categories without a colour set and includes Uncategorized in case tools.

1.1.0

Adds category name case tools (optional). No breaking changes expected.
